title: Variables
description: Holds the values of the variables defined at different levels such as project, suite or case level. Global level variables exist in their own file in root with variable.json file.

GeneratorObject.title: Generator Object
GeneratorObject.description: Represents a dynamic data generator object. Uses the Faker JSON Schema system to delegate to any @faker-js/faker method.

$gen.description: The faker method name (e.g., 'fullName', 'email', 'int'). Can be fully qualified (e.g., 'vehicle.type').

$count.description: If provided, generates an array of the specified length.

$module.description: Optional module hint for ambiguous method names (e.g., 'vehicle', 'animal').

additionalProperties.description: Arguments passed directly to the faker method. Consult fakerjs.dev/api for available parameters.

VariableValue.title: Variable Value
VariableValue.description: Values in the variable store can be primitives, arrays, objects, or generator objects. Objects can also use $count to generate an array of objects.
